description: Dependabot owns GitHub Actions; Renovate owns everything else.
ignorePaths repeats the config:recommended value without **/tests/**: the Galaxy collections of the controller image live in tests/e2e/controller/requirements.yml.

Manual steps: the cloud image (release-YYYYMMDD path plus SHA256 in tests/e2e/run.sh) and the git-cliff and actionlint versions with their checksums in tests/e2e/controller/provision.sh, and the amdgpu-install version in roles/rocm/defaults/main.yml (repo.radeon.com has no Renovate datasource) are updated by hand.

customManagers.description: AMD Device Metrics Exporter image tag (docker.io/rocm/device-metrics-exporter:v<version>)
Base images pinned by tag and digest in the Makefile
git-cliff version in the controller provision script
actionlint version in the controller provision script

packageRules.description: The tool versions in provision.sh come with a SHA256 that Renovate cannot update (not self-hosted, no post-upgrade tasks). Bump them by hand together with the checksum.
A new exporter release can add fields. The field allow-list is pinned per release, so the reviewer compares it before merging.
prBodyNotes: Before merging, diff example/config.json of ROCm/device-metrics-exporter at the new tag against the Fields allow-list in roles/gpu_metrics_exporter/vars/main.yml. Add the fields the new release introduces, or they stay off.

packageRules.description: Stay on the Ubuntu 26.04 LTS image; only its digest moves.
